newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Handling to handle freight at Bordeaux.
newsitem.headline: France Handling to handle freight at Bordeaux.

text.p: French company, France Handling, said it would begin freight handling activities at Bordeaux's Merignac airport at the beginning of next month.
"We will be taking on the handling activities previously undertaken by the Bordeaux Chamber of Commerce which runs the airport," a France Handling official told Reuters.

The official said: "Bordeaux will be added to our daily trucking network which links the Paris airports with several of France's principal regional airports such as Marseille, Toulouse, Lyon, Mulhouse, Nantes and Lille."
France Handling provides air cargo handling services to around 70 airlines based at CDG and Orly airports.
A number of these airlines are present at Bordeaux, among them British Airways, Lufthansa and KLM.
France Handling's principal shareholders are Swiss freight distribution giant, Danzas and the Paris airports authority, Aeroports de Paris.
